content: {"episode_id":"ep-05049","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) for missing prior authorization. The patient presents with recurrent presyncope and dizziness, raising concern for sick sinus syndrome in the context of known atherosclerotic heart disease. Given the recent history of a transient cerebral ischemic attack, continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias that may be contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion."}
